body.prose:
The author's own words, kept as they were said, a day to a file, newest first. Everything in this wiki grew from them, and each brief says which words it stands on. They are mostly dictated by voice, so where the transcription misheard a word, the word meant is set in brackets; typed words have their spelling set right, and nothing else is changed.
